# WO-182: Document how to run focused developer tests
Status: open (ready; worktree pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3
Source: docs/dev testing guide gap confirmed in read-only review; issued by the project owner on 2026-11-08

## Goal
Create `docs/dev/TESTING.md`, a source-cited guide that helps contributors select relevant tests and understand when browser, built-site, operating-system, and real-scheduler checks run or skip.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Explain focused pytest selection, the existing full-suite command, Ruff, and the project’s current build/site checks without claiming they ran in this work order.
- Describe the registered `browser`, `web_dist`, OS-specific, and `real_scheduler` markers from `pyproject.toml` and `tests/conftest.py`.
- Explain the `FREEMYID_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1` and `FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1` behavior: missing prerequisites otherwise skip, but fail when explicitly required.
- State that real scheduler tests require `CI=true` plus the matching OS marker; do not instruct contributors to install or trigger a real scheduler locally.
- Cite the exact source files/sections for commands and test behavior. Describe fixture isolation only at the level visible in public `tests/conftest.py`; include no private paths or configuration.
- Manually compare every command/claim against `README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, and `tests/conftest.py`. No tests apply to this documentation-only work.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `docs/dev/TESTING.md` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Do not edit `README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, `tests/conftest.py`, CI, scripts, source code, existing docs, or dependencies. Do not include credentials, real personal data, private paths, or unsupported local-environment claims.

## Check-in plan
Start after `.vendor-wt/wo-182` is prepared on `vendor/wo-182`. Report progress and completion in the worktree status file and issue #151. Nora summarizes in `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.

## Notes and decisions
- Manual source citation review is the verification method; no test command is required for this docs-only deliverable.
